assumptions.statement: Frozen v0.3 is evidence and a semantic control only; this package does not modify or re-qualify it.
No next-generation finalist or accepted compression relation exists, so finalist-specific formalization is mapped and costed but not claimed complete.
The finite-state checker uses two equality classes for every identifier, one proof slot, one nullifier, and Boolean outcomes for pool guards, parsers, verifier halves, and transfers.
A failed EVM transaction restores registry, pool, nullifier, and transfer effects atomically; the checker tests a mutation that violates this assumption but does not prove EVM semantics.

Hash collision resistance, proof-system soundness and zero knowledge, parser byte semantics, gas sufficiency, liveness, reorgs, concurrency, and deployed-chain behavior are outside the abstract checker.
Engineer-week ranges mean one experienced engineer working full time for one week and include implementation, focused review, reproducible checks, and artifact documentation.
The plan chooses one of Lean, Coq, or Isabelle for the narrow theorem-prover workstream; implementing the same development in all three is excluded.
The estimates assume a finalist relation, proof framing, Rust implementation, Solidity verifier boundary, and toolchain pins are frozen before formalization starts.

External cryptographic review, a protocol soundness theorem, new primitive proofs, remediation of findings, audits, hardware evaluation, and deployment qualification are excluded from the summed range.
All estimated costs are integer PROJECTION planning ranges, not measured delivery effort, quotes, or security acceptance.
